text:
Sam: quick follow-up from the recent streaming postmortem. want a tight list of owners, short due dates, and a minimal verification plan. summary: timeouts + partials + reconnect storms.

Rhea: i'll own partial-response fixes (safe-chunking + tests). plan: repro harness today, PR with unit tests in 5 days, staged rollout in 12 days.

Kofi: i'll take reconnect/backoff and handshake clamp in the client lib. prototype in 4 days, opt-in flag for rollout. will emit reconnect_reason telemetry.

Marta: i'll own metrics + canary orchestration. need per-request partial flags and a synthetic hourly stream from 3 regions. ETA: 3 days for metrics, canary config in 7 days.

Sam: concrete action items so PM/infra can track:
- AM-701: Add "partial_flag" to streaming responses + per-request request_id/route tags. owner: Marta. due: 2026-03-29.
- AM-702: Repro harness for mid-stream KV eviction + unit/integration tests. owner: Rhea. due: 2026-03-28.
- AM-703: Implement guarded safe-chunk flush. owner: Rhea. due: 2026-04-08.
- AM-704: Client lib: capped full-jitter backoff + handshake clamp + reconnect telemetry behind flag. owner: Kofi. due: 2026-04-02.
- AM-705: Canary plan + automatic rollback criteria (partial_ratio delta >25% or p99 latency +30%). owner: Marta & infra. due: 2026-04-12.

Kofi: i'll add client opt-out so we can disable new behavior quickly if needed. will also attach sample backoff snippet in PR.

Marta: alerts proposal: warn at partial_ratio >0.15% for 10m; page at >0.5% for 5m or synthetic fail >2 runs. will create PD ticket.

sre-bot: created ticket SRE-467 for alert tuning and assigned to Sam. link: https://redwood.internal/sre/SRE-467

ops-bot: created remediation board entry: https://redwood.internal/remediations/1972009999 and scheduled weekly check-ins starting 2026-03-25.

Sam: owners recap: Marta (metrics + canary), Rhea (server chunking + tests), Kofi (client backoff + telemetry). next quick sync: 2026-03-26 17:00 UTC. update AM tickets before then.

Rhea: opening repro PR today. will tag Kofi to coordinate client interplay tests.

Marta: will push metrics behind feature flag and start feeding staging dashboards.

Sam: closing this follow-up thread for now. if anyone hits blocks drop them here or DM. thanks. :white_check_mark:
